_read_me: This is a PROPOSAL prepared by engineering. It admits nothing: the boundary refuses it on
two independent grounds (decision != ADMIT; no binding). To become an admission the
admission authority must (1) review docs/EXP001_ADMISSION_PACKAGE.md and
docs/REAL_DATA_BOUNDARY_V0.md, (2) set decision to ADMIT, (3) fill code.commit with the
reviewed commit of strategic-integration-002, (4) place the document under
/apex-data/governance/admissions/ -- never inside a checkout or the output root,
(6) add the binding block computed by apex.world_model.real_data.boundary.binding_for(body, key)
over the document WITHOUT the binding key. Engineering does not perform steps 2-6.

scope._scope_note: train 2016-2019 and validation 2020-2021 ONLY. The evaluation period 2022-2024 and the reserve 2025+ are NOT in this proposal; unsealing evaluation is a separate decision with its own temporal_range.

availability.restricted_use: HISTORICAL_RESEARCH_ONLY: no publication or revision record exists for these bars; they may not be used to claim point-in-time availability or to model vendor revisions; receipt was bulk on 2026-08-29, so no row is evidence of what was knowable before that date except by its event time
